scope: Four previously missing references; metadata and selected primary-source sections independently rechecked. No model/package/runtime experiment.

references.title: OmniMed-Jev: Calibrating LVLM Confidence for Trustworthy Medical Multimodal Decisions via System One
references.publication_status: arXiv preprint; peer-review acceptance not verified
evidence_locations: arXiv abstract metadata and submission history
facts: Candidate-conditioned medical multimodal head with separate head training and then head plus LoRA adaptation.
Not a frozen output-projection readout; authors acknowledge supervision and training differences.
references.suggested_sentence_latex: \citet{tang2026omnimedjev} train a candidate-conditioned head and low-rank adapters for medical multimodal decisions; their calibration findings do not isolate an interface-only effect or validate our frozen readout.

references.title: On the Relation between Sensitivity and Accuracy in In-Context Learning
facts: SenSel uses label-bias-adjusted changes in hard labels under instruction or in-context-example-order perturbations for abstention.
Its perturbations and sensitivity metric differ from our candidate-order total variation; our null result is neither a replication nor a refutation.
references.suggested_sentence_latex: SenSel uses bias-adjusted sensitivity to instruction and example-order perturbations for abstention \citep{chen2023sensel}; our candidate-order TV diagnostic uses different perturbations and does not reproduce or refute that result.

references.commit_title: llama, server: add /v1/systemone API (models: laya, julia-1, lev, openjev, kev) (#29818)
references.publication_status: Official source integration; exact commit is an ancestor of prerelease b11362; binary/runtime not tested
facts: Uses decision-model metadata/template; same endpoint or GGUF format does not establish ordinary frozen-LM compatibility.
LEV Choice uses two order variants and averages semantically aligned distributions; one request is not necessarily one physical forward.
references.suggested_sentence_latex: A recent \texttt{llama.cpp} source integration exposes typed decisions for supported decision models and two-order averaging for LEV Choice \citep{llamacpp2026systemone}; this is not a matched runtime comparison with our frozen generic-LM readout.

facts: Regular provider retains full answers and response metadata; rubric path retains typed answer metadata.
